description: The official .NET library for the Tungo Platform API: typed models, retries, streaming, pagination, webhooks.

A platform-agnostic, pure-IL 64-bit build of libxmp 4.7.4 with a C# wrapper. Plays tracker modules (MOD, XM, IT, S3M, MED, DBM, FAR, MTM, PTM, 669, ULT, MDL, GDM and the rest) and renders 16-bit stereo PCM with no native code and no P/Invoke.
Ramsden Theme Engine CSS, browser JavaScript and self-hosted fonts for ASP.NET Core.
Complete Google Material Icons library for .NET MAUI (all 2,235 icons across Filled, Outlined, Rounded, and Sharp styles) with one-line .UseMaterialIcons() registration.
